'''TC-14 Jedi also hunt''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[TC-14 (GPN)|TC-14]]
* '''Published:''' 8 February 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 WHT TC-14 LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]
